CRIME REGISTER No:— 3rd June 19 32.
Diary Number:— Nature of Offence:—

Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day | 3.00 p.m. to 6 p.m. 3-6-32. | Places visited in course of investigation each day. | Lester Hospital. Office.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Three male Chinese admitted to Lester Hospital suffering from bullet wounds.

At 3.30 p.m. 3-6-32, a telephone message was received from the Lester Hospital to the effect that three male Chinese suffering from bullet wounds had been admitted to that hospital.

From enquiries at the above hospital it was learned that the three men (1) Loh Ts Hang (盧子恆), age 31, boatman, native of Shantung, residing at 2246 East Yuhang Road, (2) Lee Ping Lai (李炳來), age 21, boatman, native of Canton, residing at 634 Woochang Road and (3) Miao Foo (苗富), age 41, boatman, native of Kompo, residing at Chapei, had been admitted to the hospital at 9 p.m. 2-6-32. All three are employees of the Shanghai Customs Authorities and are part of the crew of a launch attached to the Customs Revenue Cruiser "Chuentiao". At about 9 a.m. 2-6-32 when attempting to board a junk lying off Woosung, with the intention of searching same, the crew of the junk opened fire on the launch; resulting in the death of three members of the launch, one, a Danish subject named J. Knudstrup, and two male Chinese. The above named three Chinese admitted to the Lester Hospital received bullet wounds in the same affray, the third named Miao Foo (苗富) sustaining such injuries as resulted in his death at 2.45 p.m. 3-6-32 in the above hospital.

（签名）

三名中国男性因枪伤被送入雷士德医院。

1932年6月3日下午3:30，接到雷士德医院电话通知，称有三名受枪伤的中国男性被送入该医院。

经向上述医院查询获悉，这三名男子 (1) 卢子恆 (Loh Ts Hang)，31岁，船夫，山东籍，住余杭路2246号，(2) 李炳來 (Lee Ping Lai)，21岁，船夫，广东籍，住武昌路634号，以及 (3) 苗富 (Miao Foo)，41岁，船夫，高邮 (Kompo) 籍，住闸北，于1932年6月2日晚9点入院。三人均为海关当局雇员，隶属于海关缉私舰“全兆”号 (Chuentiao) 所属的一艘汽艇船员。1932年6月2日上午9点左右，当该汽艇试图登上一艘停泊在吴淞附近的舢板并意图进行搜查时，舢板船员向汽艇开火；导致汽艇上三名成员死亡，其中一人为丹麦籍臣民 J. Knudstrup，另两名为中国男性。上述送入雷士德医院的三名中国人在同一冲突中受枪伤，其中第三人苗富 (Miao Foo) 伤势过重，于1932年6月3日下午2:45在上述医院死亡。

（签名）

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

As a result of mediation by Tu Yueh Shen (杜月笙)
a member of the French Municipal Council, the 110
employees of the Eastern Times, 708 Chekiang Road, who
were locked out by the management on June 1, pending
a settlement of the newspaper printers' strike, resumed
work at 12 noon June 3, and an extra issue of the
paper was published one hour later. While the
workers in question have made no demands nor claims
for compensation, it is reported they will participate
in the distribution of some $5,000.00 to all workers
affected by the movement.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date 26th May 19 32.

Subject (in full) Two men arrested in possession of Anti Postal Workers' Strike
pamphlets.
Made by D.S.265 Logan. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
At 12.25 p.m.26-5-32,one Lee Jung Shing (李崇兴),age 28,
Nanking,coolie employed at General Post Office,Hopecmen Road,
and residing at 23 Tsapoo Road,came to the Station with two coolies
Lieu Siau Bing (刘孝炳),28,Shantung,unemployed,3376 Robison Road,
and Zang Siau Moh (桑小毛),28,Hunting,3374 Robison Road,whom he
found in possession of a bundle of pamphlets purporting to be
issued by the Shanghai United General Labour Union,denouncing the
Postal Workers' Strike,which they were distributing to pedestrians
on the Street. The Post Office coolie alleged that the pamphlets
were false and had no connection with the Union above. Questioned,
the coolies stated that the pamphlets were given to them in the
Yih Loh Men Teashop,Hoopeh Road,by one Ding Ying Zung (丁永生),
who stated that they had been given to him by Huang Nai Juan
(黄乃权)officer in charge of General Post Office,with a promise
of 50 cents pay for every bundle distributed.
The Senior Det.,Louza,communicated the foregoing to Det.Supt.
Robertson,Special Branch,who suggested H.H. that all parties
concerned be released and the pamphlets detained. This was accord-
ingly done at 1.30p.m.same date.

加2
Officer in C/S Pl Bt
[Signature]
D.S.265.
C.D.S.80.

1932年5月26日下午12:25，一名叫李崇兴 (Lee Jung Shing) 的男子，28岁，南京人，河北路邮政总局雇用的苦力，住乍浦路23号，带着两名苦力来到捕房，他们是刘孝炳 (Lieu Siau Bing)，28岁，山东人，失业，住罗别根路3376号，以及桑小毛 (Zang Siau Moh)，28岁，海宁人，住罗别根路3374号。他发现这两人持有一捆声称由上海总工会发行的谴责邮政工人罢工的传单，并正在街上向行人分发。这名邮政苦力指控这些传单是伪造的，与上述工会无关。经讯问，两名苦力陈述传单是由湖北路益乐门茶馆 (Yih Loh Men Teashop) 的一名丁永生 (Ding Ying Zung) 给他们的，丁永生称这些传单是邮政总局负责人黄乃权 (Huang Nai Juan) 给他的，并承诺每分发一捆支付50美分。
老闸捕房高级警探将上述情况通报给特别处警司 Robertson，后者建议阁下释放所有相关人员并扣留传单。遂于当日下午1:30照此办理。

Made by C.D.I.Robertson. Forwarded by [签名]
of.

Sir,
Fifty students, including 6 females, of the Foochow Normal
School in the Province of Fokien arrived at the Shang Ling (清賓)
(Christian) Lodging House, 111 Yunnan Road at 8 a.m. May 23rd,
on a sight-seeing tour of the various colleges in Shanghai,
Soochow, Hangchow and Hankow. These men are under the
guardianship of two senior students named Kau Kwang Yui (高光遠)
and Woo Ki Yau (吳啟瑤) and intend to stay in Shanghai for
three days when they will leave for Nanking.
The expenses of the trip are being defrayed by the
Government.

Henry Robertson

File No.__________
REPORT
__________Louza Station,
Date 23-5-32. 19

Subject (in full) Two Chinese admitted to Lester Chinese Hospital suffering from
gun shot wounds.
Made by D. S. Logan Forwarded by Jno G. Calamus
C.I.

Sir,
At 12.10 a.m. 23-5-32, a telephone message was received
from the Lester Chinese Hospital to he effect hat two Chinese
had been admitted at 11.55 p.m. 22-5-32, suffering from bullet
wounds. Subsequent enquiries made by C.D.S. 80, C.I.C. 210 and
the undersigned, ascertained that the injured persons Tsang Zang
Yue (張尚玉) 50/Yenchow, boatman, and his wife Tsang Tseu Sz (張鄒
氏) while in their boat on a backwater of the Whangpoo river,
at 1 p.m. this date, picked up a piece of wood out of the water,
which was apparently the property of the Japanese Authorities
(Military), and as a result were hailed by the latter to come
ashore. Ignoring the warning of the Japanese, they were fired
on by the latter (believed to be 4 rifle shots) and as a result
sustained serious bullet wounds, after which they were detained
by the Japanese, who rendered first aid to their injuries. Some
passing boatmen who witnessed the incident, informed the injured
man's brother Tsang Shang Leo (張尚禮) boatman, N.P.A., who to-
gether with his mother visited the Japanese Military and at 5p.m.
succeeded in having the injured parties released, after which
they conducted them to Pootung, where they remained until 10p.m.,
when it was decided to take them to the Lester Chinese Hospital,
to which place they were taken by Tsang Shang Lee, above, and
Kao Tsoong Ping (高忠平) a friend. The respective Doctor's chits
states:- "Tsang Zang Yue, rupture of trachea, and fracture of
clavicles is very serious." "Tsang Tseu Sz, bullet wound in
chest; is very serious."
As Tsang Shang Leo stated that the scene of the occurrence
was in Yangtsepoo district, he was asked to direct the above
detectives to the place, and thereupon lead the undersigned to

Officer i/c H.Q.

事由（全称）两名因枪伤入院的华人被送入莱斯特的华人医院。
由 D. S. Logan 制作 经由 Jno G. Calamus 转呈
探员。

先生，
1932年5月23日凌晨12时10分，接到莱斯特华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）的电话留言，称两名华人于1932年5月22日晚上11时55分因枪弹伤入院。经第80号刑事侦缉处警探、第210号华籍探长以及本报告人随后的调查，查明伤者张尚玉 (Tsang Zang Yue)，50岁，扬州人，船夫，及其妻子张鄒氏 (Tsang Tseu Sz)，于当日下午1时在黄浦江支流上的船中，从水中捞起一块木头，该木头显然属于日本当局（军方）财产，因此被日方喝令上岸。二人无视日本人的警告，遭到日方射击（据信为4发步枪子弹），结果身受严重枪伤，随后被日本人扣留，日方对其伤势进行了急救。一些目睹此事的过往船夫通知了伤者的兄弟、北区警局辖下的船夫张尚礼 (Tsang Shang Leo)，他与母亲一同前往日本军方交涉，并于下午5时成功使伤者获释，随后将他们带至浦东，他们在那里停留至晚上10时，之后决定将他们送往莱斯特华人医院，上述张尚礼及朋友高忠平 (Kao Tsoong Ping) 将他们送至该处。 respective Doctor's chits states:- "Tsang Zang Yue, rupture of trachea, and fracture of clavicles is very serious." "Tsang Tseu Sz, bullet wound in chest; is very serious." （注：此处原文为英文医生诊断条内容，依要求保留或直译如下：） respective 医生的诊断条写明：“张尚玉，气管破裂及锁骨骨折，情况非常严重。” “张鄒氏，胸部枪伤；情况非常严重。”
由于张尚礼称事发地点在杨树浦地区，遂请他指引上述探员前往该地，并随即带领本报告人前往

总部主管警官

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No............
.........Louza.........Station,
Date 9th May 19 32.

Subject (in full) Communistic pamphlets found near Sincere Company, Nanking Road.

Made by D.S. Suhoff. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

At 6.40 p.m. 9-5-32, J.P.Cs. 1605 and 1443 brought to the station
7 Communistic Pamphlets which they have found on the ground near
the Sincere Company, Nanking Road, at 6.35 p.m. even date.

The C.P.Cs. stated that the pamphlets were thrown from the
Roof Garden of the above Company.

The roof garden was immediately visited by C.D.C. 274 and the
undersigned, but no useful information was obtained there.

7 Communistic Pamphlets are forwarded herewith.

[Signature]
D.S. 235.
C.D.C. 274.

Copy for O/C Special Branch.

H.R. 10/5.

O.R. 10/5.

报告

档案编号............
.........老闸.........分局，
日期 1932年5月9日。

事由（全称） 南京路先施公司附近发现共产主义宣传册。

制作人 D.S. Suhoff。 转呈人 [签名]

先生，

1932年5月9日下午6时40分，印捕第1605号和1443号将7本共产主义宣传册带至分局，这些宣传册是他们在当日下午6时35分于南京路先施公司附近的地面上发现的。

上述印捕称，这些宣传册是从该公司的屋顶花园抛下的。

刑侦警长第274号及本人随即前往屋顶花园查看，但未获得任何有用信息。

现随文附上7本共产主义宣传册。

[签名]
D.S. 235.
C.D.C. 274.

抄送特别课主管。

H.R. 10/5.

O.R. 10/5.
宣传册已分离

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. __________
Louza Station,
Date 29th April 19 32.

Subject (in full) Two Japanese arrested on Yunnan Road.

Made by D.P.S.Gibson. Forwarded by Jm. G. Adams
cl.

Sir,
At 8.20p.m.29-4-32,a telephone message was received at the station
from C.P.C.507 to the effect that two Japanese were in a restaurant
on Yunnan Road. They were stated to be armed with pistols.
Inspector Stubbings proceeded to the Zen Ken Tsun foodshop, where
two Japanese were found under the influence of drink. One had a
automatic pistol in his possession. The two men were brought to the
Station. Enquiries ascertained that the two Japanese had gone
to a foodshop at 1 Yunnan Road where they wished to purchase some
Chinese wine. On being informed that they could not be supplied one
of the men struck an assistant Lau Ah Yoong (赵阿荣) on the face with
his hand. The Japanese then put his hand in his hip pocket where
the outline of a pistol was observed by the assistant. A pedestrian
also observed the action and informed C.P.C.507 who telephoned the
Station. Subsequently the two Japanese proceeded to 10 Yunnan Road
where they also ordered wine before the arrival of the Police.
J.D.Cs.51 and 106 interrogated the men in the Station. They were
stated to be: 1st J.Fugita,age 24,Korean,employed as Korean Inter-
preter at the Japanese Consulate General and 2nd J.Shibasaki,age 33,
Japanese,employed as Gateman at the Japanese Consulate. In the
possession of the first named,J.Fugita,was found a Harrington and

警员。

先生，
1932年4月29日晚8时20分，捕房接到中央巡捕房507号岗亭的电话消息，称有两名日本人在云南路的一家餐馆内。据称他们携带手枪。
斯塔宾斯 (Stubbings) 巡长前往“ Zen Ken Tsun ”食品店，发现两名日本人处于醉酒状态。其中一人持有一支自动手枪。两人被带至捕房。经查询查明，这两名日本人曾前往云南路1号的一家食品店，希望购买一些中国酒。在被告知无法供应后，其中一人用手击打了店员刘阿荣 (Lau Ah Yoong, 赵阿荣) 的面部。随后该日本人将手伸入裤袋，店员观察到口袋中手枪的轮廓。一名行人也目睹了这一举动，并通知了中央巡捕房507号岗亭，后者随即致电捕房。此后，这两名日本人前往云南路10号，在警察到达之前也点了酒。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
REPORT
Louza Station,
Date April 24, 19

Subject (in full) Memorial Service and Funeral procession of Mr.Robert Short.

Made by C.D.I.Robertson. Forwarded by [Signature]

A memorial service for the late Mr.Robert Short, an American aviator
formerly in the service of the Nanking Government, who was killed
in aerial combat with Japanese aeroplanes at Ssuchiao Chenju during the
Shanghai Sino-Japanese hostilities was held in the Moore Memorial
Church, 56 Thibet Road from 2 to 3 p.m. April 24. At 3 p.m.
the funeral procession left the church for the place of intern-
ment at Hungjao Aerodrome.
The procession consisted chiefly of boy and girl Land
Scouts as well as Naval Scouts and representatives of local post-
men. A large number of Chinese Government officials also follow
ed the cortege, the chief mourners being the mother and Brother
of the deceased.
No untoward incident occurred at the service nor during
the passage of the procession through the Louza District.

Officer-in-Charg Spl. Br. Henry Robertson
C. D. I.
[Signature]

老闸捕房，
日期 193[?]年4月24日

事由（全称） 罗伯特·肖特 (Robert Short) 先生的追悼会及葬礼游行。

撰写人 C.D.I.罗伯逊 (Robertson)。 转呈人 [签名]

为前南京政府服役的美国飞行员罗伯特·肖特先生举行的追悼会于4月24日下午2时至3时在西藏路56号的慕尔纪念堂 (Moore Memorial Church) 举行。肖特先生在上海中日冲突期间于四桥陈居 (Ssuchiao Chenju) 与日本飞机进行空战时阵亡。下午3时，
葬礼队伍离开教堂，前往虹桥机场的安葬地。
游行队伍主要由男女童子军以及海军童子军和本地邮差代表组成。大量中国政府官员也跟随灵柩，主要哀悼者为死者的母亲和兄弟。
在仪式期间以及游行队伍经过老闸区的过程中，未发生任何意外事件。

特别分部主管 亨利·罗伯逊 (Henry Robertson)
C. D. I.

Louza Station,
Date April 20th, 19 32.

Subject (in full) THREATENING LETTERS RECEIVED BY MR. HSIA CHI FENG (夏奇峯)
AND MR. LING ( 林 ).

Made by C.D.I.Robertson Forwarded by [Signature] Q.

Sir,
With reference to the attached threatening letter signed
"Iron and Blood Society" demanding a sum of $10,000.00, received
by Mr. Hsia Chi Feng (夏奇峯) Counsellor to the Executive Yuen
and Adviser to the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of the National
Government at 596 Rue Pere Frog on April 14, and to one other
letter, also attached, which is exactly similar to that addressed
to Hsia Chi Feng (夏奇峯), received by Mr. Ling ( 林 )
Secretary to General Tang Shin Tze (唐生智) at 313 Route Vallon
and sent to this office by the French Police on April 18. I have
to state that an identic letter was also received by Mr. Sun Fo
(孫科) ex Minister of Communications in the Nanking Government.
By arrangements made with the French Police, detectives attach-
ed to Louza, three of whom were posted outside the Telephone
Company's premises as decoys, assisted by four men from the French
Police secreted themselves from 9.p.m. to 11.p.m. on April 19,
within sight of the premises but nothing transpired. An examina-
tion of the writing of the original letter suggests they were
composed and written by a person of limited education and as the
rendezvous mentioned is a most unsuitable place for a transaction
of the nature outlined in the letters to take place it is not
surprising the writers did not keep the appointment. The compla-
inants state that they are continually pestered by persons desir-
ous of obtaining positions and suggest one or more of these may
be responsible for the sending of the correspondence.
On the other hand there may be a political plot behind the
incident as it is known that Hsia Chi Feng (夏奇峯) who is also
Manager of the Shun Shih News Agency, 36 Szechuen Road, returned
from a mission to Geneva about three months ago and about April

报告
老闸捕房，
日期 1932年4月20日。

事由（全称） 夏奇峯先生和林先生收到的恐吓信

由 C.D.I. Robertson 制作 转呈 [签名] Q.

先生，
关于附上的由“铁血团”署名、索要10,000.00美元的恐吓信，该信于4月14日由国民政府行政院顾问兼外交部顾问夏奇峯先生在蒲石路596号收到；以及另一封同样附上的、与致夏奇峯先生的信件完全相同的信件，该信由唐生智将军的秘书林先生在法租界华伦路313号收到，并于4月18日由法国巡捕房送至本局。我必须指出，前南京政府交通部部长孙科先生也收到了一封相同的信件。
经与法国巡捕房安排，隶属于老闸捕房的侦探（其中三人作为诱饵部署在电话公司 premises 外），在四名法国巡捕房便衣人员的协助下，于4月19日晚9点至11点在看得见该场所的地方潜伏，但未发生任何情况。对原始信件笔迹的检查表明，这些信是由受教育程度有限的人撰写和书写的，由于信中提到的会面地点极不适合进行信件所述性质的交易，因此写信人未赴约并不令人惊讶。投诉人称，他们不断受到谋求职位者的骚扰，并暗示其中一人或多人可能负责寄送这些信件。
另一方面，此事背后可能存在政治阴谋，因为众所周知，夏奇峯先生（也是四川路36号顺时新闻社经理）大约三个月前从日内瓦执行任务归来，并于4月

9, 1932 came to Shanghai from Nanking with an official document
from Wang Ching Wei (汪精衛) to Wang Ching Yoong (黃金榮)
appointing the latter adviser on Military Affairs to the Execu-
tive Yuan. It is also suggested by the French Police that
owing to financial difficulties the Nanking Government contemp-
late introducing an Opium Monopoly and the writers of the letters,
knowing this are endeavouring to intimidate the recipients.
It will be noted that he hand writing of the letters under
discussion is similar to that contained in cases. Bubbling Well
F.I.R.s Nos. 267/32 and 332/32.

to Ling (林) was posted at the Fokien Road Post Office at

was posted at the same office at 1.p.m. the same day.

事由（全称） 夏奇峯先生和林先生收到的恐吓信

由 C.D.I. Robertson 制作 转呈

9日，即1932年，携带汪精卫致黄金荣的官方文件从南京来到上海，任命后者为行政院军事顾问。法国巡捕房还推测，由于财政困难，南京政府正考虑实行鸦片专卖，而信件作者知晓此事，正试图恐吓收件人。
值得注意的是，所讨论信件的笔迹与静安寺捕房案件记录第267/32号和332/32号中的笔迹相似。
据邮政当局称，致林先生的信件于1932年4月14日下午4时在福建路邮局投寄，而致夏奇峯先生的信件则于同日下午1时在同一邮局投寄。

Henry Robertson
刑事侦缉督察

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

CRIME DIARY.

"A" Division.
Louza Police Station.
17th April 1932.

CRIME REGISTER No:- 795/32.

Diary Number:- 3.
Nature of Offence:- Offence against Public Order.

Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day
2.30 to 4.15p.m.13-4-32.
3.40 to 4.30p.m.14-4-32.
2.30 to 3 p.m.15-4-32.
3.30 to 4 p.m.16-4-32.

Places visited in course of investigation each day.
Lokawei Police Stn.
Av.Joffre Police Stn.
21 Ts Ching Faung,
Tsaung Kai Wei.
Frenchtown.
599 Foochow Rd.
212 Nanking Rd.
Office.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

During the period of remand Woo Wei Yee (吴威贤) was removed from the Station cells and taken over to the French Concession by C.D.C.18 and the undersigned. With the assistance of the French Police, a visit was paid to 21 Ts Ching Faung, Tsaung Kai Wei. Woo Wei Yee on being confronted by the inmates of that address admitted that he had not lived there for the past month. He stated that he gave a false address to the Police because he was afraid that the Police would make trouble for his employers at whose place of business he resided. On being further questioned he stated that he was employed by the Ling Nyl Book shop, 599 Lung Wha Li, Foochow Road, the Manager of which is Ts Ts Yi (朱子贤) for whom he ran messages and did various odd jobs. A visit was paid to 599 Lung Wha Li and the statement of Woo Wei Yee was verified. His personal belongings were searched but nothing of an incriminating nature was found.

A visit was paid to the Kyeu Hwa Company, 212 Nanking Road where the 1st accused Zee Ts Faung (徐查方) was employed prior to his arrest. Enquiries there showed that the latter did not have a room to himself but slept in the shop. A search of his box was made but nothing of an incriminating nature could be found.

Copy for Officer i/c Special Branch.
J. Montgomery
D.S.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

罪案日志。

“A”分区。
老闸捕房。
1932年4月17日。

罪案登记号：- 795/32。

日志编号：- 3。
罪行性质：- 妨害公共秩序罪。

每日调查开始及结束时间
下午2:30至4:15，1932年4月13日。
下午3:40至4:30，1932年4月14日。
下午2:30至3:00，1932年4月15日。
下午3:30至4:00，1932年4月16日。

每日调查过程中走访的地点。
卢家湾捕房。
霞飞路捕房。
曹家渡（Tsaung Kai Wei）清芳里（Ts Ching Faung）21号。
法租界。
福州路599号。
南京路212号。
办公室。

调查记录。

在还押期间，吴威贤（Woo Wei Yee）由刑事侦缉处第18号警员（C.D.C.18）及签署人从捕房牢房提出，带往法租界。在法国警察的协助下，走访了曹家渡（Tsaung Kai Wei）清芳里（Ts Ching Faung）21号。当与该地址的住户对质时，吴威贤承认过去一个月并未居住于此。他声称向警方提供虚假地址是因为担心警方会给他雇主惹麻烦，他就住在雇主的营业场所。经进一步讯问，他称受雇于福州路龙华里599号灵尼书店（Ling Nyl Book shop），经理为朱子贤（Ts Ts Yi），他为经理跑腿并做各种杂务。随后走访了龙华里599号，核实了吴威贤的供词。对其私人物品进行了搜查，未发现任何具有指控性质的物品。

走访了南京路212号九华公司（Kyeu Hwa Company），第一被告徐查方（Zee Ts Faung）在被捕前受雇于此。那里的调查显示，后者没有单独的房间，而是睡在店里。对其箱子进行了搜查，但未发现任何具有指控性质的物品。

副本送交特别课主管警官。
J. Montgomery
副督察。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
REPORT
Louza Station,
Date April 10, 19 32

Subject (in full) TRENCH MORTOR BOMB FOUND IN A GARBAGE BIN IN AN ALLEYWAY
NEAR SAN SING THEATRE ON NEWCHWANG ROAD.

Made by D.S.Suhoff Forwarded by Jno G. Adams
C.I.

Sir,
At 8.10p.m. 10-4-32 C.P.C.1450 came to the station and reported
that a bomb has been found in a garbage bin placed in an alleyway
near San Sing Theatre (三星舞台) off Newchwang Road. S.I.Gavan
and the undersigned immediately proceeded to the place and found
one trench mortor bomb, with detonator and teil fins being removed.
The bomb was brought to the station where it will be detained till
11-4-32, when Hongkew Station will be informed to remove the same.

(copy for o/c (sb))

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
报告
老闸捕房，
日期 1932年4月10日

事由（全称） 在新闸路三星舞台附近一条小巷的垃圾桶内发现迫击炮弹。

呈报人：副巡长 Suhoff 转呈人：Jno G. Adams
华籍探员

先生：
1932年4月10日晚上8时10分，华籍警员1450号来到捕房报告称，在新闸路三星舞台（San Sing Theatre）附近一条小巷放置的垃圾桶内发现一枚炸弹。印籍巡长 Gavan 和本人立即前往现场，发现一枚迫击炮弹，其引信和尾翼已被拆除。该炸弹被带至捕房，将扣留至1932年4月11日，届时将通知虹口捕房将其移走。

（副本送交特别股主管 (sb)）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............

REPORT
Louza Station,
Date April 6th, 19 32

Subject (in full)......PAMPHLETS OPPOSING CHINESE ARMY THROWN DOWN FROM THE WING ON CO..

Made by......D.I. Hall.......................Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
At 9.10p.m. 6-4-32, C.P.C.738 brought to the Station a number
of Anti Government pamphlets that he saw thrown from the Wing On
Co. on to the Kin Wo Ka.
Enquiries in the Wing On Building were made by C.S.I.Ling
and A/C.D.S.128 but no one saw them thrown so it was not possible
to find out who had thrown them or from which floor they had been
thrown.

[Signature]
[Signature]
D.I.

事由（全称）......从永安公司大楼抛下的反对中国军队的传单..

呈报人......探长 Hall.......................转呈人 [签名]

先生：
1932年4月6日晚上9时10分，华籍警员738号将一些他在永安公司 (Wing On Co.) 看到被抛到 Kin Wo Ka（音译）的反政府传单带到捕房。
华籍高级探员 Ling 和华籍助理副巡长128号在永安大楼进行了查询，但无人看到传单被抛下，因此无法查明是谁抛下的，也无法确定是从哪一层楼抛下的。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No....................
Louza Station
REPORT
Date 2nd April 32/19
Subject (in full) Four shells found in the Sung Ka Loong alleyway.
Made by D.P.S. Gibson. Forwarded by Jas L. Adams cl.
At 5.30 a.m. 2-4-32, it was reported at the station that four
shells were lying in an alleyway off Peking Road.
Inspector Watson and U.D.C. 120 proceeded to the Sung Ka
Loong alleyway, Peking Road where they found the four shells
lying beside a refuse receptacle S.M.D. No. 470. The shells
were removed to the station.
Inquiries ascertained that the shells were found by P.D.
refuse coolie No. 245 at about 5.00 a.m. when he reported to his
foreman. Information as to how and when the shells had been
placed in the alleyway could not be obtained.
J. Gibson
D.P.S.1.

老闸捕房
报告
日期 1932年4月2日 / 19时
主题（全称） 宋家弄巷内发现四枚炮弹。
呈报人：副巡长吉布森（D.P.S. Gibson）。转呈人：警员詹姆斯·L·亚当斯（Jas L. Adams cl.）。
1932年4月2日上午5时30分，捕房接报称，北京路旁一条巷弄内有四枚炮弹。
沃森巡官（Inspector Watson）及便衣侦探第120号（U.D.C. 120）前往北京路的宋家弄（Sung Ka Loong）巷，发现四枚炮弹躺在编号为S.M.D. 470的垃圾箱旁。炮弹已被移至捕房。
经查询得知，炮弹系由公共事业部（P.D.）第245号垃圾清运苦力于上午5时许发现，随后向其工头报告。关于炮弹如何以及何时被放置在该巷弄内，未能获得相关信息。
J. 吉布森
副巡长1号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date March 14th, 1932.
Subject (in full) REPORT ON UNEXPLODED SHELL FOUND IN ZUNG TUH LI, AMOY ROAD
Made by DETECTIVE INSPECTOR HALL Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer C. I.
Sir,
At 9.10a.m. on 14th instant a telephone message was received
from C.P.C.1863 to the effect that an unexploded shell was lying
on Soochow Road near Fokien Road Bridge.
From enquiries made by D.I.Hall and C.D.S.80 it was found
that Zee Tuh Yue (徐得友) coolie 248 P.W.D. was collecting
refuse at 8.50a.m. this inst. in the Zung Tuh Li (尊德里), Amoy
Road near Chekiang Road, when he raked out the unexploded shell
from a refuse bin. He loaded it on to his wheelbarrow and at the
refuse dump on Fokien and Soochow Roads Corner, handed it over
to C.P.C.1863 who informed the Station.
D.I.Hall and C.D.S.80 went to the refuse dump and there found
the shell, of unknown origin, probably Chinese.
Enquiries in the vicinity of the alleyway did not elicit any
information as to how the shell was placed in the refuse bin.
The shell has been sent to Hongkew Station for disposal.
Det. Inspt.

老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年3月14日。
事由（全称）：关于在厦门路尊德里发现未爆炮弹的报告
具报人：警探督察霍尔（Hall） 转呈人：A. 奥德怀尔（O'Dwyer），首席督察
先生，
本月14日上午9时10分，接到来自中央捕房警员1863号的电话消息，称有一枚未爆炮弹位于福建路桥附近的苏州路上。
经警探督察霍尔及刑事侦缉股警士80号查询后查明，公共工程部苦力徐得友（Zee Tuh Yue）于本月14日上午8时50分在靠近浙江路的厦门路尊德里（Zung Tuh Li）收集垃圾时，从一个垃圾箱中耙出了这枚未爆炮弹。他将炮弹装上手推车，运至福建路与苏州路拐角处的垃圾堆场，并将其移交给中央捕房警员1863号，后者随即通知了本捕房。
警探督察霍尔及刑事侦缉股警士80号前往该垃圾堆场，在那里发现了这枚来源不明、可能系中方所有的炮弹。
在该弄堂附近进行的查询未能获得有关炮弹如何被放入垃圾箱的任何信息。
该炮弹已送往虹口捕房进行处理。
警探督察

REPORT
Date 10th March 1932.
Subject (in full) Report on General Stores and shops in Louza District.
Made by C.D.I.Hunter. Forwarded by A.O'Dwyer. S. I.
Sir,
On March 10th 1932,Wing On,Sincere and Sun Sun Companies
carried on business with open doors and closed window grilles.
The gold shops opened their doors but not the shutters or iron
grilles.
The remainder of the shops in the Louza District done business
as previously reported.
Hunter

日期：1932年3月10日。

制作人：C.D.I. Hunter。转呈人：A. O'Dwyer，巡官。

先生，
1932年3月10日，先施公司、永安公司及新新公司开门营业，但关闭了窗栅。

老闸区的其余店铺如前次报告所述进行营业。
Hunter

Subject (in full) Continued Report on Chinese Stores and shops on the Nanking
Road and Louze District.
Made by C.D.I.Hunter. Forwarded by A.O.Buyer. C. I.

Sir,
On March 8th 1932,Wing On,Sincere and Sun Sun Companies
opened to business at 9 a.m. Uniform and Chinese Detectives
were posted on the premises with strict instructions to phone
the Station in the event of any attempted intimidation. On
March 5th 1932 (Saturday) seven members of the Shanghai Labour
Union visited all three stores and attempted to intimidate the
managers against opening to business during the Chinese and
Japanese trouble, with the result that on Sunday afternoon
the above three mentioned stores did not open.
Names of the seven persons as follows:-
Li Yoong Ziang (李永祥) Shanghai Staff Committee of the
Shanghai General Labour Union.
Tong Ching Sung (湯強生)
Zung Bei Tuh (曾培德)
Yu Sien Ding (俞仙亭)
Ong Zai Foo (翁載夫)
Tseu Yoh Hsien (周學湘)
Tsang Yee Bing (張意平)
Two cards presented at Sincere Company by the above named
persons attached. In the event of another visit by these
persons endeavours will be made to arrest them providing the
Police can secure the necessary evidence, as it is obvious that
the representatives of the above named concerns cannot be relied
on for evidence if the case is brought into Court.
All gold shops in the District opened their doors, but kept
the iron grilles closed. Other shops in the District
opened as previously reported.

Hunter
C.D.I.

制作人：C.D.I. Hunter。转呈人：A.O. Buyer [注：原文如此，疑为O'Dwyer之误]，华探长。

先生，
1932年3月8日，先施公司、永安公司及新新公司于上午9时开门营业。制服警员和华人侦探被部署在现场，并接到严格指令，一旦发生任何恐吓企图，立即电话通知捕房。1932年3月5日（星期六），上海总工会的七名成员走访了这三家商店，试图在中日冲突期间恐吓经理不要开门营业，导致上述三家商店在周日下午未开门。
七人姓名如下：
李永祥 (Li Yoong Ziang)，上海总工会上海职员委员会。
湯強生 (Tong Ching Sung)
曾培德 (Zung Bei Tuh)
俞仙亭 (Yu Sien Ding)
翁載夫 (Ong Zai Foo)
周學湘 (Tseu Yoh Hsien)
張意平 (Tsang Yee Bing)
附呈上述人员在先施公司出示的两张卡片。如果这些人再次来访，警方将在获取必要证据的情况下设法逮捕他们，因为显而易见，如果案件诉诸法庭，上述公司的代表无法提供可靠证词。
区内所有金铺均开了门，但保持铁栅关闭。区内其他店铺如前次报告所述开门营业。

Hunter

pages.en:
To Nanking Road Shops,

On hearing of certain rumors on the night of March
4th,1932 most Chinese residents and shop people of Shanghai
suddenly fired crackers, bombs, hoisting flags and gathered
together large crowds shouting and applauding all over the
streets, such terrible noise and state had caused the police
to interfere.

Although it was to show a part of Patriotic action
by our people but this was senseless and useless in fact.

Merchants of Nanking Road are specially requested
in future to behave more carefulness, as the eyes of the world
are now all around in Shanghai.

The attached copy "Instructions how to use national
flag" those who are not familiar with same, to practise it
immediately.

Nanking Road
Street Union.
pages.zh:
致南京路各商店，

鉴于1932年3月4日晚听到某些谣言，上海大多数中国居民和店员突然燃放鞭炮、炸弹，悬挂旗帜，并在街头聚集大量人群，呼喊欢呼，这种可怕的噪音和状况已导致警方介入。

虽然这旨在表现我国民众的爱国行动，但这实际上是无意义且无用的。

特此要求南京路的商户今后行为更加谨慎，因为全世界的目光现在都聚焦在上海。

随附“国旗使用指南”副本，不熟悉者请立即练习。

南京路
街商联合会

REPORT
Date March 5th, 1932

Subject (in full) ONE MILLS HAND GRENADE FOUND IN THE CHINA-WARE DEPARTMENT
OF THE WING ON COMPANY ON NANKING ROAD ON 5-3-32.

Made by D.S.152 Barton Forwarded by A. O'Curry. C. I.

Sir,
At about 3.15p.m. on 5-3-32, a C.P.W. No.1346 named Lieu Ching
Sai (劉才三) employed as an inside Watchman of the Wing On Co.,
Nanking Road, brought to the Station an unexploded mills hand
grenade which had been found on the counter in the China-Ware
department today.

From enquiries made it was ascertained that at about 3.p.m. one
of the shop assistants of the China-Ware department was looking over
the China ware set out on the counter when he found a plain brown
paper parcel between some China bowls which contained an unexploded
mills hand grenade and a warning written in Chinese on a piece of
ordinary Chinese letter paper.

Translation of warning is as follows:-
WARNING!
In our first step replaced this bomb, if you still
carry on your business we will take further steps which will be
more dangerous.

The shop assistants were questioned but nobody could say when
or who put the bomb there. No China ware has been sold today, but
numerous male Chinese civilians had visited the counter during the
course of the day.

At the Station the base plug of the grenade was removed by
Inspector Stubbings, when it was found that the grenade did not
contain a detonator, which left the bomb harm-less.

The grenade is of foreign style but does not bear any makers
name or signs that would show who the makers are.

The D.C. (Crime) D.D.O. "A" and D.O. "A" were informed.

The grenade is at present detained at the Station.

D.S.152.

日期：1932年3月5日

事由（全称）1932年3月5日在南京路永安公司瓷器部发现一枚米尔斯手榴弹。

制作人：D.S.152 Barton 转呈人：A. O'Curry. C. I.

先生，
1932年3月5日下午3时15分左右，受雇于南京路永安公司内部看守的华捕第1346号刘才三（Lieu Ching Sai），将一枚未爆炸的米尔斯手榴弹带到捕房，该手榴弹是当天在瓷器部柜台上发现的。

经查询得知，下午3时许，瓷器部的一名店员在查看柜台上的瓷器时，在一些瓷碗之间发现了一个普通的棕色纸包，里面装有一枚未爆炸的米尔斯手榴弹和一张写在普通中国信纸上的中文警告条。

警告条译文如下：
警告！
这是我们采取的第一步，放置了这枚炸弹，如果你们继续营业，我们将采取更危险的进一步行动。

店员们受到了询问，但无人能说清炸弹是何时或由谁放置在那里的。今天没有售出任何瓷器，但在白天有许多中国男性平民光顾过该柜台。

在捕房，斯塔宾斯（Stubbings）巡官卸下了手榴弹的底塞，发现手榴弹内没有雷管，因此该炸弹无害。

该手榴弹为外国样式，但没有任何制造商标记或能显示制造商身份的标识。

已通知刑事处副总监（D.C. (Crime)）、“A”区副总监（D.D.O. "A"）及“A”区总监（D.O. "A"）。

该手榴弹目前扣押在捕房。

D.S.152.

Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. Supt.
Sir,
On March 3rd 1932, Wing On, Sincere and Sun Sun Stores opened as usual, with grilles still closed. At 6.p.m. 2-3-32. Mr. Wong Wen Man (黄焕南) the Manager of Sincere & Co. was approached by four youths who had the appearance of students who asked him why he opened whilst the fighting was still in progress. Mr. Wong informed them that the opening of all shops were agreed on by the management of all concerned and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. The students then left but no report was made to the Police at the time.
The remaining shops in the District are carrying on through open doors and half closed shutters. The Gold Shops remain closed and the situation is just the same as on the 2-3-32.
J. Hunter
C.D.I.

Sir,
On February 28th 1932, there were approximately 28,185 refugees
occupying 137 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, and 34 other insti-

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.______
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February, 27th 1932.
Subject (in full) Rumours that bombs are being manufactured from cigarette tins.
Made by C. D. I. Hunter Forwarded by ______
Sir,
On the 27-2-32, a telephone message was received from Mr. Peck,
D.D.O. "A". to the effect that a large number of empty cigarette
tins were stored at No. 34 & 35, Lane No. 446, Ningpo Road alleged
for the purpose of manufacturing bombs.
C.D.S. 47 Loong Ching Dong and the undersigned visited Lane No.
446 and at No. 8 & 9 a large dwelling house and from all appearance
a distributing centre forwarding articles to the Chinese Soldiers
in Chapei through the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
A Chinese named Sung Sing Bai (孫心盤) native of Ningpo is
in charge of the receiving of food etc. for the use of the soldiers,
but was absent at the time of this visit. There were five other
Ningpo men on the premises who when questioned as to the use of
probably 3,000 cigarette tins stored in the alleyway, stated that
they had been contributed by the various cigarette shops in the
Settlement and in due course would be forwarded to the soldiers
in Chapei through the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and used in
making gas masks in the event of gas being used by the Japanese.
There are a considerable number of tins of biscuits and cured
beef also on these premises.
Nothing in the line of explosives were observed.
C. D. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号______
老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年2月27日。
事由（全称）：关于利用香烟罐制造炸弹的谣言。
呈报人：C. D. I. Hunter 转呈人：______
敬启者：
1932年2月27日，接到“A”区副总监 Peck 先生的电话留言，称宁波路446弄34号和35号储存了大量空香烟罐，据称用于制造炸弹。
刑事侦缉处第47号警探 Loong Ching Dong 与本人前往446弄，在8号和9号有一栋大型住宅，从各方面看，这是一个通过中华总商会向闸北中国士兵输送物资的分发中心。
一名叫 Sung Sing Bai (孫心盤) 的宁波籍华人负责接收供士兵使用的食物等物资，但在本次走访时不在场。现场另有五名宁波男子，当被问及存储在巷子里的大约3,000个香烟罐的用途时，他们声称这些烟罐是由租界内各家香烟店捐赠的，届时将通过中华总商会运往闸北的士兵手中，一旦日军使用毒气，这些烟罐将用于制作防毒面具。
该处还存有相当数量的饼干罐和腌牛肉罐。
未发现任何爆炸物。
刑事侦缉督察。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. _______
Louza Station,
Date February 27th 19 32.

Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT

Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by ________________

Sir,
On February 27th 1932 there were approximately 29,202 refugees
occupying 137 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and 34 other institutions including alleyways etc., in the Louza District, showing a
decrease of 1,655. as compared with the figures 30,857. shown for
February 26th 1932.
The slight decrease is accounted for by several leaving the
district for different parts.

C.D.I.

老闸捕房，
日期：1932年2月27日。

事由（全称）：老闸区难民情况

呈报人：C.D.I. Hunter 转呈人：________________

敬启者：
1932年2月27日，老闸区约有29,202名难民居住在137家中式旅馆、客栈以及34所其他机构（包括弄堂等）中，较1932年2月26日记录的30,857人减少了1,655人。
人数略有减少的原因是部分人员离开本区前往其他地区。

刑事侦缉督察。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Louza Station,
Date February, 27th 1932.

Subject (in full) Further. Chinese hand grenades found on Red Cross Motor Truck.

Made by C. L. I. Hunter Forwarded by ____________________

Sir,

Further to my report dated 26-2-32, on the above subject.
Vai Ah Sing (范阿兴)
On the 27-2-32 the driver of the motor truck No.15812 on which the three hand grenades were found, was located at No. 8 Hoo Ching Yoong, Nantao and questioned. He stated that on the 25-2-32, he drove the truck to Tazang where he picked up 15 wounded soldiers, members of the 88th Division, returning to the Settlement by Markham Road Bridge where he alleges that the truck was stopped by American Marines and Settlement Police Officers and the wounded soldiers searched for arms etc. prior to entering the Settlement. The motor truck contained about 6 inches of straw on which the wounded were lying therefore it would be quite an easy matter for the soldier carrying the hand grenades to slip them under the straw on the floor of the truck.

This load of wounded soldiers were conveyed to the Tsung Tai School in the French Concession near Rue Lafayette.

Attached is a letter from Dr. B. Y. Wong, Director General of the Red Cross Society of China.

(Signature)
C. L. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

老闸捕房，
日期：1932年2月27日。

主题（全称）：续报。在红十字会卡车上发现中式手榴弹。

呈报人：C. L. I. Hunter 转呈人 ____________________

先生，

就上述主题，继我1932年2月26日的报告之后。
范阿兴 (Vai Ah Sing)
1932年2月27日，在三枚手榴弹被发现的第15812号卡车司机，于南市胡庆余堂8号被找到并接受问询。他陈述称，1932年2月25日，他驾驶卡车前往大场，在那里搭载了15名第八十八师的伤兵，经马克姆路（Markham Road，即今海宁路附近）桥返回租界。他声称，在进入租界前，卡车曾被美国海军陆战队和租界巡捕拦停，并对伤兵进行了武器等物品的搜查。卡车内铺有约6英寸厚的稻草供伤兵躺卧，因此携带手榴弹的士兵很容易将其滑入卡车地板的稻草下。

这批伤兵随后被送往法租界拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette，即今复兴中路）附近的宗泰学校（Tsung Tai School）。

随函附上中国红十字会总干事王医生（Dr. B. Y. Wong）的来信。

（签名）
C. L. I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 26th, 1932.

Subject (in full) CHINESE HAND GRENADES FOUND IN MOTOR TRUCK

Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A.O'Buyer. & Insp.

Sir,
At 7.45a.m. February 26th 1932, a Chinese Chauffeur in charge
of Motor Truck No.15812, the property of the Wan Chang Coal Co.
992 Zia Zee Road, Nantao, at present used by the Red Cross Society
for conveying wounded soldiers from Taziang to various Hospitals
in the Settlement and the French Concession, reported that, during
the night of the 25th the Motor/Truck was parked in an alleyway off
Chekiang Road near Ningpo Road, and on the morning of the 26th on
going there to start the Motor/Truck he discovered three hand
grenades of Chinese make in the truck, obviously left there by some
of the wounded soldiers who were removed from the Taziang front
to Hospital.
The three hand grenades were removed to the Station by Inspec-
tor Stubbings where they are at present detained. Enquiries are
being made at Hospitals in this district with a view to ascertain-
ing whether any of wounded soldiers detained therein are in poss-
ession of arms ammunition etc.
Dr. Wong in charge of the Red Cross Society has already been
informed that all wounded soldiers should be searched for arms
and ammunition at the clearing station before entering the Settle-
ment.
The Chauffeur will be located and questioned as to where he
entered the Settlement from Chapei with wounded soldiers.

C.D.I.

呈报人：C.D.I. Hunter 转呈人：A.O'Buyer 及 督察

先生，
1932年2月26日上午7时45分，万昌煤号（地址：南市霞飞路992号，现由红十字会用于将伤兵从大场运送至租界及法租界各医院）所属第15812号卡车的中国司机报告称，25日晚，该卡车停放在宁波路附近的浙江路一条弄堂内，26日早晨当他前去发动卡车时，在车内发现了三枚中式手榴弹，显然是某些从大场前线撤往医院的伤兵遗留在那里的。
这三枚手榴弹已由斯塔宾斯（Stubbings）督察带至捕房，目前暂存于此。正在对本区各医院进行查询，以查明其中收容的任何伤兵是否持有武器、弹药等物品。
已告知红十字会负责人王医生，所有伤兵在进入租界前，应在转运站接受武器和弹药搜查。
将找到该司机并就其从何处置地搭载伤兵进入租界一事进行问询。

C.D.I.

Louza Station,
Date February 26, 19 32.

Subject (in full) BOMB DETONATORS AND REVOLVER FOUND ON WOUNDED SOLDIERS
IN LESTER CHINESE HOSPITAL

Made by D.S.I.Willgoss Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. I.

Sir,
At 5.15p.m. 26-2-32 C.D.C.24 telephoned to the Station from
the Lester Chinese Hospital to the effect that three wounded
Chinese Soldiers had been admitted and were in possession of
explosives.
D.S.I.Willgoss immediately proceeded to the Hospital and took
over from the enquiry office attendant, 4 Mills type bomb detonators
each in a separate tin and packed in cotton wool, 1 Smith and
Wesson .32 cal. revolver No. 308544 and 1 round of .303 rifle ammuni-
tion the firing cap of which had being struck.
These articles had been found on three wounded soldiers of the
88th division who were brought to the Hospital by a Red Cross
Society Truck at 5.p.m. 26-2-32. together with 4 others of the same
division.
The seven men had been wounded some time this morning in the
Kiangwan sector and were brought direct from there this evening.
The names of the soldiers from whom the above articles were
taken follow:-
Dzau Yue Kwang ( ) in possession of 2 detonators.
Dzun Yue Zau ( ) in possession of 2 detonators.
Lieu Yuen Foo ( ) in possession of revolver and 1
round of .303 ammunition.
The detonators are not dangerous unless interfered with and
are at present locked in the C.I.D. Office Safe which bears a notice
to the effect that there are there.

Willgoss
D.S.I.

报告
老闸捕房，
日期：1932年2月26日。

主题（全称）：在莱斯特尔华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）的伤兵身上发现炸弹雷管及左轮手枪

呈报人：D.S.I. Willgoss 转呈人：A. O'Dwyer. C. I.

先生，
1932年2月26日下午5时15分，中央捕房第24号警员（C.D.C.24）从莱斯特尔华人医院致电捕房，称有三名中国伤兵入院，且身上藏有爆炸物。
D.S.I. Willgoss 立即前往医院，并从问询处 attendant 处接收了4枚米尔斯式（Mills type）炸弹雷管，每枚分别装在锡罐中并用棉絮包装，1支史密斯威森（Smith and Wesson）.32口径左轮手枪（编号308544），以及1发.303步枪子弹，其底火已被击发。
这些物品是从三名第八十八师伤兵身上搜出的，他们于1932年2月26日下午5时由红十字会卡车送至医院，同车还有该师另外4人。
这七人于今日上午早些时候在江湾地区受伤，并于今晚直接从那里送来。
被收缴上述物品的士兵姓名如下：
Dzau Yue Kwang （ ）持有2枚雷管。
Dzun Yue Zau （ ）持有2枚雷管。
Lieu Yuen Foo （ ）持有左轮手枪及1发.303子弹。
除非受到干扰，否则雷管并无危险，目前它们被锁在刑事侦缉处（C.I.D.）办公室的保险箱内，箱上贴有标示说明内有此物。

Willgoss
副督察

REPORT
Date February 26th 19 32

Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT

Made by C.L.I. Hunter Forwarded by A O'Dwyer. C. I.

Sir,
On February 26th 1932, there were approximately 30,857.
refugees occupying 139 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and 35
other institutions including alleyways etc. in the Louza District,
showing a decrease of 1,930. as compared with the figures 32,787.
shown for February 25th, 1932.
The slight decrease is accounted for by several leaving the
district for different parts.

（左侧批注：Oky / 27/2/32）

（签名：Hunter）
C.D.I.

主题（全称）：老闸区难民情况

呈报人：C.L.I. Hunter 转呈人：A O'Dwyer. C. I.

先生，
1932年2月26日，老闸区约有30,857名难民居住在139家华人旅馆、客栈以及35所其他机构（包括弄堂等）中，与1932年2月25日显示的32,787人相比，减少了1,930人。
小幅减少的原因是部分人员离开本区前往其他地方。

（左侧批注：Oky / 1932年2月27日）

Subject (in full) Supervision of Chinese hotels in Louza District.
Made by D. S. Logan Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. I.
Sir,
Reference the last para. of report on above, dated
24-2-'32, further information was on this date, received by C.D.
C. 164 that the officer Ru Tsong Yui, therein mentioned, is
attached to the 88nd Route Army, and not the 19th Route Army,
also that the 88nd Route Army is now on its way from Honan
to Shanghai for the purpose of assisting the Chinese Forces
presently engaged in hostilities with the Japanese.
D. S. Logan

先生，
关于上述 dated 1932年2月24日的报告最后一段，中央捕房于本日收到第164号补充信息，其中提到的军官 Ru Tsong Yui 隶属于第八十八军，而非第十九路军；此外，第八十八军正从河南前往上海，目的是协助目前与日军交战的中国军队。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 25th 32
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. I.
Sir,
On February 25th 1932, there were approximately 32,787.
refugees occupying 139 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, other
institutions, alleyways etc., in the Louza District, showing a
decrease of 374. as compared with the figures 33,161. shown for
February 24th, 1932.
The slight decrease is accounted for by a number of refugees
leaving the Settlement for Hongkong and Canton together with others
proceeding to peaceful areas South of the Shanghai City.
（批：26/2/32）
SI
（签名：J. Hunter）
C.D.I.

主题（全称） 老闸区的难民
制作人 C.D.I. Hunter 转呈人 A. O'Dwyer. 首席督察。
先生，
1932年2月25日，约有32,787名难民居住在老闸区的139家中国旅馆、客栈、其他机构、弄堂等处，与1932年2月24日显示的33,161人相比，减少了374人。
这一轻微减少的原因是部分难民离开租界前往香港和广州，另有部分难民前往上海市以南的和平地区。
（批：1932年2月26日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ______
Louza Station
REPORT
Date February 24th, 1932

Subject (in full) SUPERVISION OF CHINESE HOTELS IN LOUZA DISTRICT.

Made by D.S. Logan Forwarded by A.O'Buyer C.I.

（批：Pt. S.B. / J. Fraser / 25/2）

Sir,
C.D.C.242 reported that at 3.p.m., on this date, about 40 employees of the World Book Company (世界书局) 5 Dalny Road, (Office and Shop at 100 Foochow Road) who are presently unemployed owing to the Sino-Japanese hostilities, met in room 209 of the Chung Nan Hotel to arrange with their employer Sung Tzi Fung (沈克方) for the payment of their wages, etc. The meeting which was orderly dispersed about 2 hours later.
Information was reported by C.D.C.164 that an officer of the 19th Route Army, Ru Tsong Kyi (冉忠義) has occupied Rooms 425 and 428 of the Far Eastern Hotel, since 22-12-31, and that he frequently receives as visitors Lieut. Yang Kyi Chung (楊其昌) and other officers of the same army.
C.D.C.323 reported that Yeu Koh Tsang, mentioned in report dated 23-2-32, left the Great China Hotel on the morning of 24-2-32.

（签名）
（签名）Logan
D.S.265.

（批注：DI）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 ______
老闸捕房
报告
日期 1932年2月24日

主题（全称） 老闸区华人旅馆的监管。

制作人 D.S. Logan 转呈人 A.O'Buyer C.I.

（批注：Pt. S.B. / J. Fraser / 2/25）

先生，
中央侦探课第242号报告称，当日下午3时，世界书局（地址：大连路5号，办事处及店铺位于福州路100号）约40名因中日战事而目前失业的员工，在中南旅馆209室集会，与其雇主沈克方（Sung Tzi Fung）商谈支付工资等事宜。该会议秩序井然，约2小时后解散。
中央侦探课第164号报告提供情报称，第十九路军军官冉忠義（Ru Tsong Kyi）自1931年12月22日起占据远东旅馆425和428房间，并经常接待同属该军的杨其昌（Yang Kyi Chung）中尉及其他军官来访。
中央侦探课第323号报告称，在1932年2月23日的报告中提及的 Yeu Koh Tsang，已于1932年2月24日上午离开大华饭店。

（签名）
（签名）Logan
D.S.265.

（批注：DI）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Louza Station
REPORT
Date February 21, 19
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I.Hunter Forwarded by A.O'Dwyer. C.I.
Sir,
On February 21st 1932, there were approximately 33,489.refugees,
occupying 140 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, 25 other institutions,
alleyways, shelters etc., in the Louza District, showing an increase
of 1,931 as compared with the figures 31,558 shown for the 20-2-32.
The increase of refugees is accounted for by the Japanese
advance from Woosung, Kiangwan and the districts in that area.
（批：22/2/32）
SI
（签名：Hunter）
C.D.I.

主题（全称） 老闸区的难民
制作人 C.D.I.Hunter 转呈人 A.O'Dwyer. C.I.
先生，
1932年2月21日，老闸区约有33,489名难民，居住在140家华人旅馆、客栈、25所其他机构、弄堂、收容所等处，较1932年2月20日显示的31,558人的数字增加了1,931人。
难民人数的增加是由于日军从吴淞、江湾及该地区推进所致。
（批注：1932年2月22日）
SI

G. 25,000-1-31
Copy for o/c (A.B)
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 22nd/□ 32
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT.
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A. O'Byrne, C. I.
Sir,
On February 22nd 1932, there were approximately 32,689 refugees
occupying 138 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, and other refugee
institutions, including alleyways, showing a decrease of 800 as
compared with the figures 33,489. shown for the 21-2-32.
The decrease is due to some refugees find lodgings in the French
Concession and returning to their native places.
Refugees
22/2/32
SI
C.D.I.

老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年2月22日/□
事由（全称）老闸区难民情况。
呈报人：刑事侦缉督察亨特 (C.D.I. Hunter) 转呈人：首席督察 A. O'Byrne
敬启者，
1932年2月22日，约有32,689名难民栖身于138家中式旅馆、客栈及其他难民收容机构（包括弄堂），相较于1932年2月21日显示的33,489人，减少了800人。
人数减少的原因是部分难民在法租界找到住所，或返回原籍。
难民
1932年2月22日
SI

Form No. 8
G. 28,069-1-30
Copy for O/C (Louza)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 24th 1932
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT.
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A. O'Sullivan. C. I.
Sir,
On February 24th 1932, there were approximately 33,161 refugees
occupying 139 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, other institutions,
alleyways etc., in the Louza District, showing an increase of 1,163
as compared with the figures 31,998. shown for the 23-2-32.
The increase of refugees is accounted for by the Japanese
advance from Woosung, Kiangwan and the districts in that area.
(Hunter) 24/2/32
C.D.I.
S1

档案号
老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年2月24日
事由（全称）老闸区难民情况。
呈报人：刑事侦缉督察亨特 转呈人：首席督察 A. O'Sullivan
敬启者，
1932年2月24日，老闸区约有33,161名难民栖身于139家中式旅馆、客栈、其他机构及弄堂等处，相较于1932年2月23日显示的31,998人，增加了1,163人。
难民人数增加的原因是日军从吴淞、江湾及周边地区推进。
(亨特) 1932年2月24日
刑事侦缉督察

February 24th, 1932.

THE GRAND TOTAL NUMBER OF REFUGEES REMAINING IN LOUZA DISTRICT AND RESIDING IN 139 CHINESE HOTELS AND LODGING HOUSES IS 25,483. Form No. 3
G. 25,000
Copy for O/C (C.R)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 23rd 32.
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A. Sayer. C. I.
Sir,
On February 23rd 1932, there were approximately 31,998. refugees
occupying 139 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, other institutions,
alleyways etc. in the Louza District, showing a decrease of 691.
as compared with the figures 32,689. shown for February 22nd, 1932.
The decrease is accounted for by a number of refugees leaving
the Settlement for Hongkong and Canton together with others proceed-
ing to peaceful areas South of the Shanghai City.
（签名）
24/2/32
SI
（签名）
C. D. I.

供行动处主任（刑事侦缉）存副本
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号。
老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年2月23日。
事由（全称）老闸区难民情况
呈报人：刑事侦缉督察亨特（C.D.I. Hunter） 转呈人：首席督察赛耶（A. Sayer. C. I.）

敬启者，

1932年2月23日，约有31,998名难民栖身于老闸区的139家中式旅馆、客寓、其他机构、弄堂等处，较1932年2月22日记录的32,689人减少了691人。

人数减少的原因是一部分难民离开租界前往香港和广州，另有一部分人前往上海市以南的和平地区。

（签名）
1932年2月24日
SI
（签名）
C. D. I.

COPY FOR O.C. SPECIAL BRANCH
$1
Louza
February 23rd, 32.
FURTHER TO ATTACHED REPORT ON RAPE OF CHINESE GIRL.
D.C.I.Willgoss
Sir,
The girl Wong Kwei Sze has been further questioned but is unable to give any more information regarding this matter.
The reason for her ignorance of the topography of Shanghai is due to the fact that she only recently came from Soochow.
She was questioned by Dr. D.B.Clay, also by a Chinese lady doctor, a Chinese nurse, a male Chinese from the Red Cross Society, a Chinese detective, and myself but without useful result. The doctor's certificate a copy of which is below states that her mental condition does not seem clear.
Doctor's Certificate:-
The girl was brought to this hospital on Saturday 20th accompanied by a woman friend. She gave the history that the girl had been raped the day before by seven soldiers.
The girl comes from Soochow and her mother has been working in Shanghai but had disappeared and the girl says she came up to look for her mother and was out looking when she was molested by the soldiers and taken into a small cottage and there raped first by one and then by all the others in turns.
She says she was held firmly by her arms and legs during this time- one man to an arm or leg. Bleeding began and they became frightened and left her. She was still bleeding when brought here the next morning and on examination the external parts showed no signs of violence, but inside I found a large laceration of the posterior vaginal wall almost through into the rectum.
By packing some medicated gauze into the wounded vagina the bleeding was controlled.
Now we are keeping the girl in bed and treating her with douches and local medication and provided the wound doesn't remain

1932 年 2 月 23 日
关于所附中国女孩被强奸报告的补充说明。
副督察长 Willgoss

先生，
女孩 Wong Kwei Sze 已再次接受讯问，但无法就此事提供更多信息。
她对上海地理环境不熟悉的原因在于她最近刚从苏州来。
她接受了 D.B. Clay 医生、一位中国女医生、一名中国护士、红十字会的一名中国男性成员、一名中国侦探以及我本人的讯问，但未获得有用结果。医生的证明书（副本附后）指出，她的精神状态似乎不清醒。
医生证明书：-
该女孩于 20 日星期六由一位女性朋友陪同送至本院。她陈述称，该女孩前一天被七名士兵强奸。
该女孩来自苏州，其母在上海做工但已失踪，女孩称她前来寻找母亲，在外寻找时遭到士兵骚扰，被带入一间小屋，先被一人强奸，随后被其他人轮流强奸。
她说在此期间她的手臂和腿被牢牢按住——每人按住一只手臂或腿。出血开始后，他们感到害怕并离开了她。第二天早上她被送来时仍在出血，检查显示外部器官没有暴力痕迹，但在内部我发现阴道后壁有大面积撕裂，几乎通入直肠。
通过在受伤的阴道内填塞一些药棉纱布，出血得到控制。
目前我们让女孩卧床休息，并进行冲洗和局部药物治疗，只要伤口不保持

Louza Station,
REPORT
Date 20/2/32 xxx
Subject (in full) R.A.P.E. FEMALE CHINESE
Made by D.S.I. Willgoss. Forwarded by A. O'Byrne. C.I.
(批：Perused)
Sir,
At 9.15.a.m. 20/2/32 a telephone message was re-
ceived from the Lester Chinese Hospital to the effect that a
female Chinese had been admitted after having been raped.
D.S.I. Willgoss and C.D.C. 182 proceeded to the
hospital but were unable to question the female as she was
being operated on. At 3.p.m. 20/2/32 the hospital was again
visited and the girl interviewed.
She gave the name of Wong Kwie See (王桂女) age
17, native of Soochow and stated that she has been living in
Chapie until the 19/2/32 and that her mother ran away owing to
the Sino-Japanese hostilities. The exact locality in Chapie in
which she lived she is unable to say. During the afternoon of
the 19/2/32 she set out in search of her mother and at about
3.30.p.m. was stopped by a number of Japanese Marines who took
her to a house where 7 of them raped her and then turned her
out onto the road. She does not know on which road this took
place. She then walked about 20 yards and fell down and lay on
the road for about an hour where she was found by another
female Chinese who took her home where she remained until
about 8.a.m. 20/2/32 when she was taken by the said female
to the Lester Chinese Hospital in a public ricksha. She does
not know where her benefactress' home is apart from that it is
at Yang Kah Tie (楊家宅) (Miller and Hanbury Roads locality)
and this fact she knows only because she was told so by the
female.
She is in great pain and dazed and is unable to
make a clear statement. OVER.

主题（全称） 强奸中国女性
制作人 副督察长 Willgoss。转呈人 A. O'Byrne. 首席督察
(批注：已阅)
先生，
1932 年 2 月 20 日上午 9 点 15 分，接到莱斯特华人医院的电话消息，称一名中国女性在被强奸后入院。
副督察长 Willgoss 和华人侦探主任 182 号前往医院，但因该女性正在接受手术而无法进行讯问。1932 年 2 月 20 日下午 3 点，再次访问医院并对该女孩进行了面谈。
她报姓名为 Wong Kwie See（王桂女），年龄 17 岁，籍贯苏州，并称在 1932 年 2 月 19 日之前一直住在闸北，其母因中日敌对行动而逃跑。她无法说出她在闸北居住的具体地点。1932 年 2 月 19 日下午，她出发寻找母亲，大约在下午 3 点 30 分被数名日本海军陆战队士兵拦下，带至一处房屋，其中 7 人强奸了她，然后将她扔到路上。她不知道此事发生在哪条路上。随后她走了约 20 码倒下，躺在路上约一小时，后被另一名中国女性发现并带回家，她一直待在那里，直到 1932 年 2 月 20 日上午 8 点左右，由该女性用公共黄包车将她送往莱斯特华人医院。除了知道恩人的家在杨家宅（米勒路和汉璧礼路区域）外，她不知道具体地址，这一事实也是由该女性告知她的。
她非常痛苦且神志恍惚，无法做出清晰陈述。续后。

Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I.Hunter Forwarded by A.S. Smyer. C. I.
Sir,
On February 19th 1932, there were approximately 31,224 refugees
occupying 141 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and 18 other refugee
institutions including alleyways and shelters in the Louza District
showing a decrease of 687 as compared with the figures 31,911 shown
for the 18-2-32.
The decrease is accounted for by numerous refugees living Shang-
hai for their native place.
（左侧批注：Refugees repatri）
C.D.I.

Form No. 3
G. 25,000-31
Copy for OIC (MB)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 20th, 1932.
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A J Fryer. C. I.
Sir,
On February 20th 1932, there were approximately 31,558.
refugees occupying 140 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses, 21 other
institutions, alleyways, shelters etc., in the Louza District,
showing an increase of 334 as compared with the figures 31,224.
shown for the 19-2-32.
The slight increase is owing to the Japanese proposed drive
on a large scale on Chapei and the surrounding districts, which
was scheduled for the 20-2-32.
21/2/32
C.D.I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No...........
"A"
Louza Station,
Date February. 12, 1932.

Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT

Made by G.D.I.Hunter Forwarded by P. O'Dwyer. C. Insp.

Sir,
On the 12-2-32 the number of Chinese Refugees remaining in
Louza District and residing in 148 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses
and other institutions were approximately 33,082 showing an appro-
ximate increase of 168 against the figures 32,914 shown for
11-2-32.
The small increase is accounted for by the 4 hour truce from
8.a.m. to 12 noon on the 12-2-32 when hostilities were called off
in the Chapei area to allow relief operations to be carried out
amongst the suffering civilians, as during that period a very large
number of refugees already residing in this district left for Cha-
pei in an endeavour to collect what personal belongings they could.
Some of whom were unable to return to the Settlement before 12 noon
when the Thibet Road Gates were closed.
Thousands of refugees filed through the Louza District between
the hours of 8.a.m. and 1.p.m. practically all of whom entered the
French Concession proceeding South with what personal effects they
could carry.
Between 4.p.m. and 5.p.m. the Soochow Creek between Chekiang
and Shanse Road Bridges was still congested with boats carrying
refugees.

12/2/32
$1,
Hunter
C.D.I.

报告
档案编号...........
"A"
老闸捕房，
日期：1932年2月12日。

事由（全称）老闸区难民情况

由 G.D.I.Hunter 制作，经警司 P. O'Dwyer 转呈。

先生，
1932年2月12日，滞留在老闸区并居住在148家中式旅馆、客栈及其他机构的华籍难民人数约为33,082人，较1932年2月11日记录的32,914人增加了约168人。
人数小幅增加的原因在于，1932年2月12日上午8时至中午12时实行了4小时停战，闸北地区停止敌对行动，以便在受难平民中开展救援工作；在此期间，大量已居住在本区的难民离开前往闸北，试图收集他们能带走的个人财物。其中一些人未能在中午12时西藏路大门关闭前返回租界。
上午8时至下午1时之间，成千上万的难民穿过老闸区，几乎所有人都携带着能带走的个人物品进入法租界并向南行进。
下午4时至5时之间，浙江路桥与山西路桥之间的苏州河段仍挤满了载有难民的船只。

1932年2月12日
$1,
Hunter

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
........A.B........Station,
Date February 13, 19 32
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by A.O. Burger. C. I.
Sir,
On February 13th 1932 the number of refugees remaining in
Louza District and residing in 143 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses
and other institutions, were approximately 34,350. showing an
increase of 1,268. against 33,082. the figures shown for 12-2-32.
The increase is accounted for by the wild rumour that the
Japanese Forces were prepared to shell the Kiangnan Arsenal, and
the return of a few refugees from Chapei who failed to gain admission into the Settlement after 12 noon on the 12-2-32.
Further, on the 13-2-32 between 4 and 6.p.m. approximately
600 refugees all natives of Kompo were admitted to the Thien Zaan
Woo Dai (天蟾舞台) (Theatre) No.345 Foochow Road under the management of the famous Koo S (顧四).
The food is supplied from outside, no fires, or cigarette
smoking is allowed on the premises.
Hunter
C.D.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
........A.B........分局，
日期 1932年2月13日
事由（全称） 老闸区难民
呈报人 C.D.I. Hunter 转呈人 A.O. Burger. C. I.
先生，
1932年2月13日，滞留在老闸区并居住在143家中式旅馆、客栈及其他机构的难民人数约为34,350人，较1932年2月12日显示的33,082人增加了1,268人。
增加的原因是有关日军准备炮击江南制造局的荒谬谣言，以及少数在1932年2月12日中午12点后未能获准进入租界的闸北难民返回。
此外，1932年2月13日下午4时至6时之间，约600名籍贯均为Kompo (音译)的难民被接纳进入位于福州路345号的天蟾舞台（Theatre），该剧院由著名的顾四（Koo S）管理。
食物由外部供应，场所内严禁生火或吸烟。
Hunter
C.D.I.

pages.en:
"A"
February 13, 32

REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT

C.D.I. Hunter

Sir,

On February 13th 1932 the number of refugees remaining in
Louza District and residing in 143 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses
and other institutions, were approximately 34,350. showing an
increase of 1,268. against 33,082. the figures shown for 12-2-32.

The increase is accounted for by the wild rumour that the
Japanese Forces were prepared to shell the Kiangnan Arsenal, and
the return of a few refugees from Chapei who failed to gain admission into the Settlement after 12 noon on the 12-2-32.

Further, on the 13-2-32 between 4 and 6.p.m. approximately
600 refugees all natives of Hongpo were admitted to the Thien Zoen
Woo Dai (天蟾舞台) (Theatre) No.345 Foochow Road under the management of the famous Koo S (顧四).

The food is supplied from outside, no fires, or cigarette
smoking is allowed on the premises.

C.D.I.

Form No. 3
G. 25,000-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
"A"
Louza Station,
Date February 15th 1932

Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT ON THE 15-2-32

Made by C.D.I.Hunter Forwarded by

Sir,

On February 15th 1932 there were approximately 33,908. refugees
occupying 142 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and 11 other institu-
tions in the Louza District, showing a decrease of 1,528 as compared
with 35,436. the figures shown for the 14-2-32.

The decrease is accounted for by the transfer of 213 refugees
from the Zung Chi Dong No.566 Yunnan Road to the Great World in the
French Concession, and others proceeding to their native places in
the country, Hangchow, Ningpo and elsewhere

（批：16/2/32）
（批：SI）

（签名：Hunter）
C. D. I.

表格编号 3
G. 25,000-1-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案编号
“A”
老闸捕房，
日期 1932年2月15日

事由（全称） 1932年2月15日老闸区难民情况

呈报人 C.D.I.Hunter 转呈人

敬启者，

1932年2月15日，约有33,908名难民栖身于老闸区的142家中式旅馆、客寓及11所其他机构，较1932年2月14日所示的35,436人减少了1,528人。

人数减少的原因在于：213名难民从云南路566号众志东院（Zung Chi Dong）转移至法租界的大世界游乐场，其余难民则返回内地原籍，如杭州、宁波等地。

（批注：1932年2月16日）
（批注：SI）

（签名：Hunter）
C. D. I.

Form No. 2
G. 5000-7-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
"A"
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 14, 1932

Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT

Made by C.D.I.Hunter Forwarded by

Sir,
On February 14th 1932 there were approximately 35,436 refugees
occupying Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and other institutions
in the Louza District, showing an increase of 1,086 against
34,350. the figures for 13-2-32.
The increase is accounted for by the arrival of numerous
refugees from Woosung, Chengju and Chapei Western District.
On the 14-2-32, 100 refugees left the Tien Zoen Theatre
No.345 Foochow Road and returned to their native place Kompo,
approximately 500 still remain in this Theatre.

（左侧批注：）
Refereed
15/2/32

（右下签名：）
C. D. I.

SI

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号
"A"
老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年2月14日

主题（全称）老闸区难民情况

由 C.D.I.Hunter 编制 转呈者

先生，
1932年2月14日，老闸区内占据中国旅馆、寄宿舍及其他机构的难民约有35,436人，较1932年2月13日的34,350人增加了1,086人。
增加的原因是来自吴淞、真如和闸北西区的众多难民抵达。
1932年2月14日，100名难民离开福州路345号的天蟾舞台，返回其家乡高邮，约500人仍留在此剧场内。

（左侧批注：）
已阅
1932年2月15日

（右下签名：）
C. D. I.

Subject (in full) Refugees in Louza District.

Made by D. I. Hall Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. I.

Form No. 3
G. 2408-1-31
Copy for O/C (S.B.)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
"A"
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date February 17th 1932.
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT ON THE 17-2-32.
Made by C.D.I.Hunter Forwarded by Dean Chivers
Sir,
On February 17th 1932 there were approximately 32,425. refugees occupying 142 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and 14 other institutions and alleyways in the Louza District, showing a decrease of 879 as compared with 33,304 the figures shown for the 16-2-32.
The decrease is accounted for by the transfer of approximately 500 refugees through the Lung Chi Dong 566 Yunnan Road, to different institutions in French Concession and elsewhere.
540 refugees remain in the Tien Zoen Theatre No.345 Foochow Road.
The influx of refugees to this District has also shown a decrease during the past few days.
（批：O/C S.B. 18/2/32）
SI
C.D.I.

制作人：C.D.I. Hunter 转呈人：Dean Chivers
先生，
1932年2月17日，约有32,425名难民居住在老闸区的142家中式旅馆、客栈以及14其他机构和弄堂中，与1932年2月16日显示的33,304人相比，减少了879人。
减少的原因是约500名难民通过云南路566号的龙济东（音译）被转移至法租界及其他地方的不同机构。
仍有540名难民留在福州路345号的天韵舞台。
过去几天进入该区的难民流入量也有所减少。
（批注：特别分部主管 1932年2月18日）
SI
C.D.I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
" A "
Louza Station,
Date February 18th, 32.
Subject (in full) REFUGEES IN LOUZA DISTRICT
Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by H. O'Dwyer. C. I.
Sir,
On February 18th 1932, there were approximately 31,911. refugees
occupying 141 Chinese Hotels, Lodging Houses and 17 other institut-
ions including alleyways in the Louza District, showing a decrease
of 514 as compared with the figures 32,425. shown for the 17-2-32.
The decrease is accounted for by several refugees leaving for
cheaper lodgings and their native places, whilst there are few new
arrivals.
（签名）
18/2/32
（签名）
C.D.I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
"A"
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date Jan. 31st, 19 32.

Subject (in full) SUSPICIOUS BEHAVIOUR OF MALE CHINESE

Made by D.S.Logan Forwarded by

Sir,
At 5.15p.m. on 31-1-32, Special C.D.C.850 came to the station
with one Wong Ah Kung (黃阿根; 15 years, Footung, apprentice, 24
Sinza Road, when he arrested at the corner of Peking-Thibet Roads,
for noting on a piece of paper the Nos. of Special Chinese and regu-
lar police men on duty in that area. In his possession was found
a piece of paper on which was written the following, No.776, 3311,
713, 369, 351, 3361, 550 and 750, in lead pencil.
Questioned at the station by C.D.C.242 and the undersigned,
he stated that he was instructed by one "Ah Fah (阿发)". This
man, he said, could be located on Peking Road, consequently C.D.C.
242 and the undersigned proceeded to accompany the boy to that road.
On Yunnan road he indicated a male Chinese as being the man Ah Fah.
This man was brought to the station for enquiries, where he gave his
name as Yang Siau Son (楊小生) alias Ah Fah (阿发) 26/Bamboo
Fence Builder, Zaushing, 26 Sinza Road, and denied all knowledge of
the affair. As nothing further was elicited against these men, they
were released at 9.00p.m. same date.

D.R. 1/2
back with
H.P.

W Logan
D.S.865.
C.D.C.242.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号
“A”
老闸捕房，
报告
日期：1932年1月31日

主题（全称） 一名中国男子的可疑行为

制作人：D.S. Logan 转呈人

先生，
1932年1月31日下午5时15分，第850号华籍特别侦探带着一名黄阿根（Wong Ah Kung；15岁，浦东人，学徒，住新闸路24号）来到捕房。该少年在北京路与西藏路转角处被捕，原因是他正在一张纸上记录在该区域执勤的华籍特别侦探及正规巡捕的编号。在他身上发现一张用铅笔写着以下数字的纸条：776、3311、713、369、351、3361、550和750。
经第242号华籍侦探及具名人于捕房内讯问，他称是受一名叫“阿发（Ah Fah）”的人指使。他说此人可在北京路找到，因此第242号华籍侦探及具名人随即陪同该少年前往该路。在云南路上，他指认一名中国男子即为阿发。该男子被带回捕房接受查询，他自称杨小生（Yang Siau Son），别名阿发（Ah Fah），26岁，竹匠，祖籍赵兴(音译)，住新闸路26号，并否认与此事有任何关联。由于未能从这些人身上获取更多不利证据，他们于同日晚上9时被释放。

D.R. 1/2
随附
H.P.

W Logan
警佐 865号
华籍侦探 242号

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.…………
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date January 31st 1932

Subject (in full) DISTURBANCE AT NANKING-CHEKIANG ROAD CORNER

Made by D.S.LOGAN Forwarded by A. O' Buryen. C. I.

Sir,
While returning from dispersing a demonstration on Avenue
Edward VII in the C.I.D. Van, at about 11.40a.m. 31-1-32, a party
of Police observed a large crowd of Chinese assembled on Nanking
Road East of Chekiang Road Corner, among whom were several male
Chinese of the student type, frantically shouting to the crowd to
rise up and attack the Japanese. One Wang Tsing (王幹) alias
Wang King (王金) 22/Canton, merchant, formerly at 64 Paoshan
Road, presently unemployed, N.F.A. who appeared to be the ring
leader was taken into custody by D.S.Logan. A foreigner, Oivind
Hansen, Norwegian, 1196 Bubbling Well Road, came forward and iden-
tified him as the leading agitator. Another male Chinese Foo Kyi K
Kang (傅子光), 22/Canton, student Shanghai College, presently on
vacation 76 Hart Road was arrested by C.P.C.1242 for similarly
inciting the crowd. The arrested men were cautioned and released
at 4.p.m. in accordance with directions of D.D.O."A".

Logan
D.S.265.
C.D.S.52.

I.C. (Brine)
Information

2. T. Keen

老闸捕房，
报告

主题（全称） 南京路与浙江路转角的骚乱

制作人：D.S. LOGAN 转呈人：A. O' Buryen. 刑事调查处处长

先生，
1932年1月31日上午11时40分左右，当乘坐刑事调查处车辆从爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）驱散示威人群返回时，一队警员观察到大量中国人聚集在南京路东段与浙江路转角处，其中包括几名学生模样的中国男子，他们疯狂地向人群呼喊，号召起来攻击日本人。一名王幹（Wang Tsing），别名王金（Wang King），22岁，广东人，商人，原住宝山路64号，目前无业，非本地居民协会成员（N.F.A.），其看似为首者，被警佐Logan拘捕。一名外国人，挪威人Oivind Hansen，住静安寺路1196号，上前指认他为主要的煽动者。另一名中国男子傅子光（Foo Kyi K Kang），22岁，广东人，上海学院学生，现放假期间住哈同路76号，因同样煽动人群被第1242号华籍巡长逮捕。根据“A”区副总监的指示，被捕人员受到警告后于下午4时释放。

Logan
警佐 265号
华籍侦探组长 52号

REPORT

File No............
Louza Station,
Date 2nd Feb. 1932.

Subject (in full) Assault on Korean Subject.

Made by D.S.I.Willgoss. Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. I.

At 8.15 p.m.2-2-32,a telephone message was received from
C.P.C.1956 to the effect that a Korean was being assaulted on
Fokien Road. S.I.Bell and D.P.S.Smith C.D.S.149 immediately
proceeded to the scene and on Canton Road near Tsing Yoh Ka found
a Korean named Ying Ping Koh (尹炳高) lying injured, and
immediately conveyed him to the General Hospital where he was
detained. The Doctor's certificate states that he is suffering
from injuries to face and head.
Enquiries in the vicinity elicited the facts that the injured
man went to the Woo Sing Lodging House to engage a room. He was
wearing foreign style clothing and a number of loafers thinking
him to be a Japanese entered the lodging house with the intention
of assaulting him. The proprietor of the lodging house knew
the Korean as he had stayed at the lodging house previously and
told the loafers not to assault him as he was not a Japanese. While
this was going on C.P.S.1152 and A/C.P.S.1412 who were on duty
at Canton Road and Tsing Yoh Ka corner were informed by Chinese
and they proceeded to the lodging house and attempted to prevent
the assault. By this time a crowd of 200 people had gathered
and the two C.P.Ss. were prevented from assisting the Korean.
The Korean was dragged from the lodging house along the Tsing Yoh
Ka to Canton Road being assaulted en route by the crowd and then
left on the road where he was found by the above mentioned Police
officers. No arrests were made.

主题（全称） 袭击朝鲜籍民案

制作人：D.S.I. Willgoss. 转呈人：A. O'Dwyer. 刑事调查处处长

1932年2月2日晚上8时15分，接到第1956号华籍巡长的电话报告，称有一名朝鲜人在福建路遭到袭击。警司Bell和第149号华籍侦探组长Smith立即赶赴现场，在广东路近青岛路处发现一名名叫尹炳高（Ying Ping Koh）的朝鲜人受伤倒地，并立即将其送往总医院留医。医生证明显示其面部和头部受伤。
经在附近查访得知事实如下：伤者前往伍星客栈（Woo Sing Lodging House）租赁房间。他身穿西式服装，一群游手好闲之徒误以为他是日本人，便进入客栈意图殴打他。客栈老板认识这名朝鲜人，因为他此前曾在此住宿，便告诉那些流氓不要打他，因为他不是日本人。在此期间，在广东路与青岛路转角处执勤的第1152号华籍巡长和第1412号代理华籍巡长接到中国人通知，遂前往客栈试图阻止袭击。此时已聚集了约200人的围观群众，两名华籍巡长无法协助该朝鲜人。该朝鲜人被人群从客栈沿青岛路拖至广东路，途中遭到殴打，随后被弃置在路上，后被上述警员发现。未实施逮捕。

....sale a quantity of Chinese silver shields on Peking Road on 1/2-32.
Made by.........D.S.Barton................Forwarded by............................................................

Sir,
At about 4.15p.m. on 1-2-32 C.P.C.'s 2460 and 2706 brought to
the Station an Indian named Basakha Singh (Ex S.P.C.265 ) who was
slightly under the influence of Liquor who resides at No.58 Gt.
Western Road, who they stated was offering for sale on Peking
Road near Fokien Road seven Chinese silver shields of various
sizes and shapes, inscribed on each shield was the name of a
Chinese Doctor Li Pih Seng (李碧聲) in Chinese characters, but
no address.
On being questioned by C.D.I.Hunter, Basakha Singh stated that
at about 3.p.m. 1-2-32 he was proceeding along Paoshing Road,
Chapei, when a Japanese Marine, sold him the shields for $2.00.
No enquiries could be made anywhere near the vicinity of Pao-
shing Road owing to the present restrictions of that part Settle-
ment.
The Doctor's name does not appear in any telephone or Hong List
Books, and nobody can be located who can state his present address.
Basakha Singh was detained at the Station until he became sober,
when he was again questioned when he told the same story.
He was detained until 4.a.m. on 2-2-32 (Owing to the curfew
order) when he was severely cautioned and allowed to go home.
The shields have been detained at the Station, pending the
owner claiming them.

制作人.........D.S. Barton................转呈人............................................................

先生，
1932年2月1日下午4时15分左右，第2460号和2706号华籍巡长将一名叫Basakha Singh的印度人（前特别巡捕265号）带到捕房。此人略有醉意，住大西路58号。据巡长称，他在北京路近福建路处兜售七面大小形状各异的中国银盾，每面银盾上均刻有中文名字李碧聲（Li Pih Seng），但无地址。
经第Hunter号华籍侦探讯问，Basakha Singh称，1932年2月1日下午3时左右，他正沿着闸北宝兴路行走，一名日本海军陆战队士兵以2美元的价格将这些银盾卖给了他。由于目前对该部分租界区域的限制，无法在宝兴路附近进行任何查访。
在任何电话簿或行名录中均未出现该医生的名字，也无人能提供其当前地址。
Basakha Singh被拘留在捕房直至清醒，再次受审时他讲述了同样的故事。
他被拘留至1932年2月2日凌晨4时（因宵禁令），随后受到严厉警告并被允许回家。
银盾已被扣押在捕房，等待物主认领。

（签名）

were detained at No. 68 Boone Road an Emergency Japanese Hospital
suffering from severe injuries to body and head and that they were
the two men who were assaulted at Peking & Fokien Roads corner at

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Central Station,
REPORT
Date February 5, 19 32.
Subject (in full) Two Japanese being assaulted by a mob of Chinese at Peking and
Fokien Roads corner.
Made by J.D.S.I. Nakamura Forwarded by Jas. G. Adams C.I.
Sir,
With reference to the above D.S.I. Nakamura was instructed
by C.D.I. Mason to make enquiries.
At 8:30 p.m. on the 5-2-32, D.S.I. Nakamura proceeded to the
Japanese hospital, 68 Boone Road and saw two Japanese who were
unable to speak as they were in a very serious condition.
The wives of the victims who were in the hospital stated that
the names of the victims were K. Yuki and M. Ogata residing at 12
and 12A Woosung Road respectively and they were both employed by
Eastern Ice Manufacturing Company, 521 Chining Road.
At 9 a.m. to-day they left their homes together without say-
ing where they were going and at 2:30 p.m. they (the wives) were
informed of the assault by the hospital authorities. The wives
immediately visited them at the hospital and were informed by the
second victim named M. Ogata that at 1:30 p.m. to-day whilst they
were proceeding in ricshas on Peking Road near Fokien Road they
were stopped by a mob of Chinese and assaulted by them with stones
and other weapons. They could not remember after that as they
were rendered unconscious.
D.S.I. Nakamura could not obtain further results to enqui-
ries other than the particulars contained in the Occurrence Book
at Louza Station which states that at about 1:30 p.m. five Japan-
ese males were riding in ricshas on Peking Road when they were
attacked by a crowd of Chinese..
On visiting the hospital where the two injured men are now
detained no information could be obtained other than that they
are both suffering from serious head wounds.
A further visit will be paid to the hospital on 6-2-32.
Mason.
Senior Detective (Central)
Officer i/c Special Branch.
J. D. S. I.

日期 1932年2月5日。
事由（全称）两名日本人在北京路与福建路转角处遭一群中国人袭击。
制作人 日籍副巡长（D.S.I.）中村 转呈人 警探长（C.I.）Jas. G. Adams

先生，
关于上述事项，中央侦探督察长（C.D.I.）梅森指示日籍副巡长（D.S.I.）中村进行调查。
1932年2月5日晚上8时30分，日籍副巡长（D.S.I.）中村前往布恩路68号的日本医院，探视了两名日本人，因二人伤势极重，无法言语。
受害者的妻子当时也在医院，她们称受害者姓名为 K. Yuki 和 M. Ogata，分别居住于吴淞路12号和12A号，二人均受雇于其宁路521号的东方制冰公司（Eastern Ice Manufacturing Company）。
今日上午9时，他们一同离家，未告知去向；下午2时30分，院方通知其妻子二人遇袭的消息。妻子们随即前往医院探视，并从第二名受害者 M. Ogata 处获悉，今日下午1时30分左右，当他们乘坐人力车行经靠近福建路的北京路时，被一群中国人拦下，并遭对方用石块及其他武器袭击。此后二人失去知觉，记忆中断。
除老闸捕房《记事簿》中记载的内容外，日籍副巡长（D.S.I.）中村未能通过调查获得更多结果。《记事簿》记载：下午1时30分左右，五名日本男子乘坐人力车行经北京路时，遭到一群中国人的袭击。
在探访目前收治这两名伤员的医院时，除得知二人头部均受重伤外，未获得其他信息。
将于1932年2月6日再次前往医院探访。
梅森。
高级侦探（中央）
特别处主管警官。
日籍副巡长（J. D. S. I.）

Form No. 8
G. 25,000-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
of a Special Branch "A"
Louza Station,
REPORT

File No.
Date February 8th, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Shells drop in Louza District

Made by D.I.Hunter Forwarded by A.Toye. C.i.

Sir,
At about 10.10p.m. February 8th 1932, three shells (probably
Chinese) fell in the Louza District East of Pekien Road South of
Peking Road. No.1185 Peking Road, No.39 and 34 North Wusieh alleyway
off Peking Road and No.43 Zung Tuh Li ( ) South Wusieh alley-
way were struck by fragments of the shells which made holes in the
walls of the above numbered premises. No one was injured. Enquiries
proceeding.

Received

J. Hunter
D. I.
pages.zh:
表格编号 8
G. 25,000-1-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务处“A”
老闸捕房，
报告

档案编号
日期 1932年2月8日。

事由（全称） 炮弹落入老闸区

制作人 D.I. Hunter 转呈人 A. Toye. C.i.

先生，
1932年2月8日晚10时10分左右，三枚炮弹（可能为中国军队发射）落在老闸区，位于北京路以南、北四川路以东。北京路1185号、北京路旁北吴淞弄39号和34号，以及南吴淞弄宗德里（原文不清）43号被炮弹碎片击中，在上述门牌号的房屋墙壁上造成孔洞。无人受伤。调查正在进行中。

收讫

J. Hunter
督察长

Form
G. 25,000-1-31
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
REPORT
Louza Station
Date 11.2.32 19
Subject (in full) attached.
Made by J. I. Hall Forwarded by
Sir,
There is a small increase of 900 refugees
over the figures of the previous day. This is believed to be
due to refugees coming by boat from in and places where fighting
is expected to take place, and also from the vicinity of
Chenju, where air raids are being made.
J. I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No....................
Louza Station,
Date Feb. 9th. 19 32

Subject (in full) Wing On, Sincere & Sun Sun & Co.

Made by C.D.I. Hunter Forwarded by: A. Dwyer C. I.

Sir,
At 9.30 a.m. 9-2-32, the above companies opened to business after the managers of the three companies held a meeting at which all three decided to open at the above mentioned time on the 9-2-32.

At 11.30 a.m. same date these three stores closed and from enquiries made by C. I. O'Dwyer and the undersigned it was ascertained that the amalgamated Street Unions and students brought presure to bear on the companies employees through the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. This the management of the afore-mentioned concerns will not openly admit, but from other sources it was gathered that this was the chief reason for closing, whilst one third of the employees of the three companies are disgruntled and are putting forward the excuse that business should not be carried on by the companies whilst the Japanese are attacking China.

The managers of Wing On and Sincere Companies are frightened that if they opened to business the disgruntled employees, students and loafers would make an attempt to smash the stores and loot.

Another meeting will be held tonight 9-2-32 and the Chief Inspector in charge of Louza will be informed as to whether the stores will re-open on the 10-2-32 or not. Whilst open on the 9-2-32, Foreign and Chinese Uniform Police with Chinese detectives were on duty at all stores.

C. D. I.

报告
档案编号....................
老闸捕房，
日期 1932 年 2 月 9 日

事由（全称）先施、永安及新新公司。

呈报人：刑事侦缉督察亨特 (Hunter) 转呈人：首席督察德怀尔 (Dwyer) C. I.

先生，
1932 年 2 月 9 日上午 9 时 30 分，上述各公司开始营业，此前这三家公司的经理举行了一次会议，三方均决定于 1932 年 2 月 9 日上述时间开门营业。

同日中午 11 时 30 分，这三家商店关门。经首席督察奥德怀尔 (O'Dwyer) 及本报告人查询后查明，各马路商界联合会和学生通过上海总商会向这些公司的雇员施加了压力。上述商号的管理层不愿公开承认这一点，但从其他渠道获悉，这是关门的主要原因；同时，这三家公司中有三分之一的雇员心怀不满，他们提出的借口是，在日本人攻击中国期间，公司不应继续营业。

永安公司和先施公司的经理担心，如果他们开门营业，那些心怀不满的雇员、学生及游手好闲之徒会试图砸毁商店并进行抢劫。

今晚（1932 年 2 月 9 日）将举行另一次会议，届时将告知负责老闸捕房的首席督察，这些商店是否将于 1932 年 2 月 10 日重新开业。在 1932 年 2 月 9 日营业期间，外籍和华籍制服警察以及华籍侦探在所有商店执勤。

pages.en:
Extract from the Morning State dated May 14th, 1933.

Foreigner injured in the Arcade Bar, Central Road.

At 11.30 a.m. '13-5-33 a phone message was received
from Bubbling Well Station to the effect that a foreigner
had been admitted into the Country Hospital suffering from
injuries received in Central District.

Enquiries made by D.S.I. Crawford revealed that the
injured man was one Fred Pierce, American. It appears that
Pierce whilst drinking in the "Arcade Bar" became abusive and
quarrelsome with a foreigner who had entered the bar with him
and the latter at Pierce's invitation struck him on the face
with his open hand causing him to stagger and fall, hitting
the base of an iron stairway and inflicting a wound 3 to 4
inches above the right eye. Pierce was removed to the
Country Hospital by Max Sausloff, Chief employed in the bar.
Dr. Branch who attended the injured man refused Police admis-
sion to interview Pierce as his condition is very serious.

The foreigner who struck Pierce is only known by
sight to the employees of the bar and he has not yet been
traced. Dr. Sellet of U.S. Consulate has been informed.
Further enquiries proceeding.

（签名）
MAY 15 .33
pages.zh:
摘自1933年5月14日《晨报》（Morning State）。

外国人在中央路 Arcade Bar 受伤。

1933年5月13日上午11时30分，静安寺捕房打来电话称，一名外国人因在中央区受伤被送入同仁医院（Country Hospital）。

经刑事侦缉督察克劳福德（Crawford）调查，伤者名为弗雷德·皮尔斯（Fred Pierce），美国人。据悉，皮尔斯在“Arcade Bar”饮酒时，对一名与其同入酒吧的外国人进行辱骂并发生争吵，后者应皮尔斯之邀，张开手掌击打其面部，致其踉跄跌倒，头部撞到铁楼梯底部，造成右眼上方3至4英寸处的伤口。皮尔斯由该酒吧领班马克斯·索斯洛夫（Max Sausloff）送往同仁医院。主治布兰奇医生（Dr. Branch）以伤者病情危重为由，拒绝警方探视皮尔斯。

殴打皮尔斯的那名外国人仅被酒吧员工面熟，目前尚未追踪到其人。已通知美国领事馆的塞莱特医生（Dr. Sellet）。进一步调查正在进行中。

（签名）
1933年5月15日

REPORT
Central Station,
Date September 27, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Threats re alleged purchases of Japanese goods.

Made by D. S. Darvill. Forwarded by a / k: Ollerson

Sir,
At 5:30 p.m. on the 27-9-32 Mr. O. C. Boisseree, Customs
Freight Broker, 115 Kiangse Road, telephoned the Station that his
compradore had received threats by telephone.
Enquiries by D. S. Darvill and C.D.C. 65 elicited that three
telephone messages were received by Mr. H. S. Shu, compradore, at
5:20 p.m., 5:23 p.m. and 5:25 p.m. even date, from an unknown
Chinese speaking Shanghai dialect, who untruthfully alleged that
the complainant's firm were dealing in Japanese goods and that if
Mr. H. S. Shu continued this practice he would be assaulted or
attacked by angry men. The sender of the messages refused to
give any particulars for whom he was acting and the three messages
were all of similar type. The Telephone Company were communicated
with but could not trace the calls owing to the Automatic system,
and Mr. H. S. Shu could give no useful information to the Police
that would assist in identifying the sender of the messages.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
T. N. Darvill
D. S. 179.

Cy
Senior Detective (Central).

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. 76/32.
Central Station,
Date March 14, 1932.

Subject (in full) Two grenades found in the M/car parking enclosure on Peking Road.

Made by D. S. Satula. Forwarded by Jas. G. Adam C.I.

Sir,
At 5:15 p.m. 14-3-32 a telephone message was received from C.P.C. 3000 that two bombs were found in a garage at 74/6 Peking Road.

Along with C.D.C.s 143 and 212 the undersigned proceeded to the above address and found that two Chinese Army hand grenades were lying near the fence inside of enclosure of M/car parking space on Peking Road between Szechuen and Kiangsi Roads. One of grenades was lying near the entrance and had the handle broken probably being run over by a m/car and the other also beside the fence but about ten yards further. Both of the grenades had the caps screwed on so it appears they were not thrown with intent to cause explosion, but were dropped near the wire fence by some one who wanted to get rid of them.

From enquiries made it was ascertained that the grenades were discovered at about 5 p.m. even date by some passer by who informed the accountant at the Standard Oil Company, Gasoline Pump inside the inclosure, who in his turn reported to C.P.C. 3000.

The accountant one named Tseu Tsung Yue (諸宗岳) on being questioned, stated that he did not notice when and by whom the grenades were placed. The space is used for parking of the owner driven cars so that there were no drivers inside. Two coolies employed for car cleaning also failed to notice the grenades before.

Through enquiries were made in the vicinity but no useful clue was obtained and no one was found who saw by whom the grenades were left.

By order of Sr. D. O. "A" Mr. Kerrigan, Inspector Stubbing.

（左侧手写批注：15/3/32）

报告

档案号 76/32。
中央捕房，
日期：1932年3月14日。

事由（全称）：在北京路汽车停车围栏内发现两枚手榴弹。

制作人：D. S. Satula。转呈人：警司 Jas. G. Adam。

先生，
1932年3月14日下午5:15，接到中央电话交换台3000号来电，称在北京路74/6号的一个车库内发现两枚炸弹。

本人与中央巡捕房第143号和212号巡捕一同前往上述地址，发现两枚中国军队手榴弹躺在四川路与江西路之间北京路汽车停车空间围栏内的栅栏附近。其中一枚手榴弹躺在入口处，手柄断裂，可能是被汽车碾过所致，另一枚也在栅栏旁，但再远约十码处。两枚手榴弹的引信盖都已拧紧，因此看来并非意图引爆而投掷，而是由某人为摆脱它们而丢弃在铁丝网栅栏附近的。

经查询得知，手榴弹是于当日约下午5时被路人发现的，该路人通知了围栏内标准石油公司汽油泵处的会计，后者随即向中央电话交换台3000号报告。

经询问，该名会计诸宗岳（Tseu Tsung Yue）表示，他没有注意到手榴弹是何时由何人放置的。该场地用于停放车主自驾车辆，因此内部没有司机。两名受雇洗车的苦力此前也未注意到手榴弹。

虽在附近进行了查询，但未获得有用线索，也未找到目击者看到是谁留下了手榴弹。

奉“A”区高级警官 Kerrigan 先生之命，由 Stubbing 督察执行。

（左侧手写批注：1932年3月15日）

Subject (in full) 78 Szechuen Road, Temporary office, Commercial Press.
Made by C. D. I. MacDermott. Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
C.D.S. 86 reports that at 3 p.m. 12-3-32 the five represen-
tatives referred to in attached file again attended the above
office. They were seen by one Bau Ching Ling (鮑慶林) who was
formerly in charge of the Chapel factory, (Mr. Y. W. Wong being
absent and said to be sick). Soon after their arrival about 50
ex-workers of the printing Department put in an appearance.
They all demanded a return of the amount they alleged stood to
their credit under the former bonus scheme in the Company, some
of them had their books to prove their claim and the others said
most of such books had been destroyed. They were inclined to be
rowdy but C.D.S. 86 spoke to and quietened them. They were told
by Bau to return on 14-3-32 at 3 p.m. and they departed shouting
they would all return on Monday (14-3-32).
I am detailing two extra Chinese Detectives to attend the
above office between 2 and 5 p.m. 14-3-32.
Yours obediently,
[Signature] MacDermott
C. D. I.

先生：
华探第86号报告称，1932年3月12日下午3时，附件档案中提及的五名代表再次前往上述办事处。他们由前礼拜堂工厂负责人鲍庆林（Bau Ching Ling）接见（王云五先生缺席，据称生病）。在他们到达后不久，约50名印刷部前雇员出现。他们均要求归还据称在公司原有奖金制度下记入其贷方的款项，其中一些人持有账簿以证明其主张，另一些人则称大多数此类账簿已被销毁。他们倾向于闹事，但华探第86号与其谈话并使其平静下来。鲍庆林告知他们于1932年3月14日下午3时返回，他们离开时高喊将于星期一（1932年3月14日）全部返回。
我现指派两名额外华探于1932年3月14日下午2时至5时前往上述办事处值守。
敬礼，
[签名] MacDermott
C. D. I.
